d: Building Blocks Facades is redefining architecture through cutting‑edge Glass Fiber Reinforced Concrete (GFRC), Ultra‑High Performance Concrete (UHPC), and custom façade systems. Our work bridges architectural ambition with technical execution—delivering landmark façade projects through integrated design, advanced manufacturing, and disciplined installation.

The Project Manager (PM) is responsible for leading façade projects from kickoff through installation, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, within budget, and to Building Blocks’ rigorous quality standards. This role represents the next progression from Assistant Project Manager and requires greater ownership over schedules, budgets, client coordination, risk management, and cross‑functional alignment.

The PM ensures seamless coordination between engineering, design, fabrication, logistics, and field teams while developing strong relationships with general contractors, construction managers, architects, and developer clients.

The Project Manager is expected to operate with urgency, ownership, and precision—removing obstacles, enhancing clarity across teams, and driving world‑class execution throughout the full project lifecycle.
q: Strong understanding of façade systems (GFRC, UHPC, curtain wall, or related).
Proven project management capability in construction or façade environments.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to interpret technical drawings, schedules, and commercial documents.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Strong ownership mentality and ability to thrive in fast‑paced environments.
Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or related field.
PMP certification preferred but not required.
Proficiency in project management software (MS Project, Primavera, Procore) and Microsoft Office Suite.
5–10 years of construction project management experience, preferably in façade systems, GFRC, UHPC, or specialty building envelope work. (Bridging APM’s 3–7 years and SPM’s 10+ years).
Travel to job sites or manufacturing facilities as required for project execution. (>25% typical)

Note to Recruitment Agencies: We love your enthusiasm, but we prefer to connect with our candidates directly. Building Blocks is not partnering with external agencies for this search, so please save the outreach, we’ve got this one covered. Any resumes submitted without a signed agreement in place will become the property of Building Blocks and no fees will be paid.
r: Lead façade projects from kick‑off through final installation.
Maintain and drive adherence to detailed project plans, schedules, logistics plans, and submittal timelines.
Identify risks early, propose solutions, and ensure rapid mitigation throughout project lifecycle.
Ensure deliverables meet project specifications, quality standards, and client expectations.
Build and maintain effective relationships with GCs, CMs, architects, and developer clients.
Serve as the primary day‑to‑day project contact, ensuring clear and proactive communication.
Resolve conflicts promptly and maintain alignment across all project partners.
Deliver a consistently high‑quality client experience.
Define scope and ensure alignment with internal teams and external partners.
Develop and manage project budgets; monitor cost performance and forecast needs.
Track progress against schedules; implement adjustments as needed to maintain critical path.
Support change order development and commercial documentation.
Maintain accurate project documentation, including meeting minutes, action items, RFI logs, submittal logs, schedules, and risk registers.
Ensure consistent updates across internal systems and cross‑functional teams.
Issue clear, timely communication and escalate risks before they become issues.
Coordinate between fabrication, logistics, and field teams to ensure seamless sequencing.
Participate in site coordination meetings; resolve field issues with urgency.
Track installation progress and ensure alignment with project schedule.
Mentor Assistant Project Managers and support their development.
Foster a collaborative, high‑performance team environment.
Set clear expectations and enforce accountability across stakeholders.
Identify workflow inefficiencies and propose systematic improvements.
Maintain clarity in responsibilities, timelines, and deliverables.
Support the evolution of standardized processes and project documentation methods.

q: Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
A higher degree or relevant professional certifications (e.g., CPA, CIA, ACCA) are highly preferred.
Ongoing studies towards obtaining additional professional certifications are an advantage.
4–6 years of relevant experience, preferably in internal audit or risk management.
Experience in the financial services sector is an advantage.
In-depth knowledge of IAS/IFRS, audit reporting, compliance, and financial analysis.
Familiarity with the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Standards for the International Professional Practices Framework (IPPF) or equivalent audit standards.
Experience in risk assessment and management reporting.
Fluent in both English and Arabic.

Consultative Solutions Builder : Ability to act as a trusted advisor and solutions-oriented partner, working collaboratively with stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement and build tailored solutions that address business needs.
Analytical Problem-Solver : Demonstrates strong problem-solving skills, using hypothesis-driven thinking and rigorous analysis to identify root causes and develop effective recommendations.
Attention to Detail : Highly focused on accuracy and precision, with a strong ability to manage complex tasks with meticulous attention to detail.
Goal-Oriented : Strong drive to achieve results, with the ability to work efficiently under tight deadlines while maintaining a high standard of work.

Excellent Communication Skills : Ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, and to influence stakeholders through persuasive presentations and well-structured reports.
Team Player : Collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively with subordinates, peers, and superiors, building strong relationships across the organization.
Self-Motivated : Demonstrates initiative and ambition, with a proactive attitude and a willingness to take on new challenges and make a positive impact.
Ownership and Accountability : Takes full responsibility for the quality and outcomes of assigned work, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently and effectively.

Adaptable and Resilient : Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment, with the ability to adjust to changing organizational needs and contribute to the growth of a newly established internal audit function.
Mentorship and Development Focus : Passion for developing talent and supporting the professional growth of UAE nationals, especially within the context of internal audit.
r: Develop a deep understanding of EIA’s operations and processes to implement and enhance internal audit practices effectively.
Support the Chief Internal Auditor in creating the multiyear Audit Plan and the annual Internal Audit Plan, ensuring the audits are comprehensive, efficient, and effective.
Lead and conduct regular and ad hoc audits across all EIA functions, including investments, in collaboration with the Chief Internal Auditor and Internal Audit Manager.
Plan and oversee individual audit assignments , including the preparation of notification letters, audit programs, and summary memos, in accordance with the audit manual.
Coordinate audit activities with managers to ensure alignment on schedules and audit scope.
Foster strong business relationships with line management to maintain ongoing communication and ensure audit recommendations are implemented.
Perform detailed audits across all EIA departments , identifying risk management deficiencies, control gaps, fraud red flags, compliance issues, and opportunities for operational improvement.
Review and assess internal controls , business processes, and policies, recommending improvements to mitigate risks and enhance the protection of EIA’s assets.
Stay current with industry trends and best practices in internal auditing, ensuring EIA's audit processes are aligned with global standards.
Supervise both internal and external (co-sourced) auditors , ensuring audit quality and adherence to standards.
Formulate actionable recommendations to mitigate identified risks, improving overall operational effectiveness.
Prepare comprehensive audit reports documenting findings, and communicate them with key stakeholders, including the Chief Internal Auditor and Internal Audit Manager.
Report on audit progress , detailing work completed, scope, materiality, findings, and recommendations.
Support audit activities related to portfolio companies as required, ensuring compliance and risk mitigation across the organization.
Ensure compliance with EIA’s Internal Audit Manual and the IIA’s Standards for International Professional Practices Framework (IPPF) for internal auditing.
Perform follow-up audits on agreed actions from previous audit reports and present findings to relevant committees.
Contribute to the preparation of materials for the Audit Committee , including reports and presentations.
Coach and mentor UAE nationals , fostering talent development and promoting knowledge transfer, particularly in internal audit practices.
Manage departmental administrative tasks , such as maintaining the IA Share Folder.
Support other audit-related tasks as directed by the Chief Internal Auditor.

d: Hitachi, Ltd. is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior SAS Commissioning Engineer to lead and execute the commissioning activities for Substation Automation Systems (SAS) projects. This role involves ensuring the successful integration, testing, and operational readiness of complex SAS solutions, adhering to international standards and company specifications.
q: Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Electronics & Computer Science
Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in commissioning Substation Automation Systems (SAS)
Demonstrated expertise in the configuration, testing, and troubleshooting of various protection relays (e.g. Hitachi, ABB, Siemens, GE, SEL IEDs)
In-depth knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 61850, Modbus, and Goose messaging.
Strong understanding of power system protection principles, control philosophies, and substation design.
Proficiency in using commissioning tools and software (e.g., PCM600, Agile, Digsi, Wireshark).
Experience with SCADA systems integration and testing.
Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and single-line diagrams.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to diagnose complex technical issues under pressure.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively to project sites, both domestic and international.

r: Lead and manage all aspects of SAS commissioning activities, including planning, scheduling, execution, and reporting for complex substation projects.

Perform comprehensive functional testing, inter-operability testing, and system integration testing of SAS components, including protection relays, control systems, RTUs, SCADA interfaces, and communication networks.
Develop and execute detailed test plans, procedures, and reports in accordance with project requirements and industry best practices (e.g., IEC 61850).
Configure and troubleshoot various SAS devices and systems, including but not limited to protection relays (e.g., SEL, Siemens, ABB), bay control units, and communication processors.
Conduct FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing) and SAT (Site Acceptance Testing) with clients, ensuring all specified requirements are met.
Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues encountered during commissioning, collaborating with design, engineering, and manufacturing teams.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior commissioning engineers and technicians.
Ensure strict adherence to safety regulations and quality control procedures during all commissioning activities.
Prepare and submit accurate commissioning documentation, including test reports, punch lists, and as-built drawings.
Interface directly with clients, consultants, and contractors to ensure smooth project execution and client satisfaction.
Participate in project reviews, risk assessments, and lessons learned sessions.
Stay updated with the latest industry trends, technologies, and standards related to SAS and power systems.

d: Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

The Shop Manager at IKEA is responsible for leading all aspects of the store operations to achieve business goals, including maximizing sales and efficiencies while ensuring long-term profitability. This involves strategic decision-making in collaboration with the Country Management team and coaching the performance of the store team. As the Shop Manager, you will track store progress, manage budgets, and facilitate the training and development of staff to ensure high levels of co-worker engagement. Customer satisfaction is a priority, and you will implement initiatives to enhance the customer experience, while maintaining operational excellence and safety standards. You play a key role in the overall performance of the store and maintaining good relationships between IOS and the local Franchisee.
q: Proven leadership abilities with the capacity to inspire and develop teams.
Strong networking skills and ability to build relationships.
Ability to create an inclusive environment that embraces diversity and embodies IKEA values.
What Qualifies You For The Role
University Degree in Business Administration or Commerce.
Minimum of 7-10 years of high volume or multi-unit Retail Management experience.
Deep knowledge of local market demographics and economic conditions.
Genuine interest and knowledge of Home Furnishings and customers.
Computer literacy in MS Office including Outlook.

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.

We don’t just operate stores; we shape retail experiences. From launching brands like Watsons and Kiabi to our regions for the first time, to investing in digital innovation, AI capabilities, the customer experience and loyalty platforms, we are constantly redefining the future of retail.

With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.
Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.
r: Lead and develop all areas of the store to meet business objectives, maximize sales, volumes and efficiencies, and ensure long term profitability.
Make local operational and strategic decisions in conjunction with the Country Management team.
Track store progress using commercial growth review documents and operational review checklist to ensure operational standards consistently improve.
Prepare and achieve annual budgets related to sales, gross margin, manpower, and operating expenses, monitoring and authorizing operating expenses monthly.
Provide effective leadership and promote an environment of tolerance and understanding for a culturally diverse team, supporting learning and development plans for co-worker training.
Deliver high levels of customer engagement and satisfaction through company and local initiatives, ensuring operational excellence.
Ensure that the store adheres to the 'STORE IN SHAPE AS NEW' policy and is safe for customers and co-workers.
